'''Augusto César Leal Angulo''' (3 June 1931 – 29 January 2013) was a Mexican chemist and politician affiliated with the [[National Action Party (Mexico)|PAN]]. He served as Senator of the [[LX Legislature of the Mexican Congress|LX]] and [[LXI Legislature of the Mexican Congress|LXI]] Legislatures of the Mexican Congress representing [[Sinaloa]]. He also served as Deputy between 1994 and 1997.<ref>{{cite web|title=Perfil del legislador|url=http://sil.gobernacion.gob.mx/Librerias/pp_PerfilLegislador.php?SID=&Referencia=2303261|publisher=Legislative Information System|accessdate=16 December 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Muere César Leal Angulo, fundador del PAN en Veracruz|url=http://www.oem.com.mx/elsoldeorizaba/notas/n2862239.htm|accessdate=16 December 2013|newspaper=El Sol De Orizaba|date=30 January 2013}}</ref>
